theme: A travel day pointed at Toronto.
greeting: A clear morning at home, then north you go. You land in Toronto tonight, and the ICGN board dinner tomorrow is what this trip is really about.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental still open
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 Household task has been overdue since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market; book refundable now before holiday inventory vanishes.

needsAttention.title: December break destination undecided
needsAttention.detail: The p2 decision was due Sept 30 with a book-by of Oct 15, now past. Six people over three weeks of the holidays means inventory thins out a little more each day it waits.

needsAttention.title: ICGN board dinner prep
needsAttention.detail: You arrive tonight and the dinner at Lee Restaurant is tomorrow. Worth landing with a few governance talking points and a sense of who to seek out, given the board search.

schedule.title: Flight to Toronto (PD 526)
schedule.detail: Tampa TPA to Toronto, lands 7:17 PM ET

flagged.title: A LinkedIn message awaits your reply
flagged.detail: LinkedIn is nudging you about an unread message you haven't answered, worth a look given the board and role search.

flagged.title: Amex flagged account changes
flagged.detail: An 'important account changes' notice from American Express, likely a terms update but worth a glance to be sure it's nothing actionable.

inbox.noise: The rest is Black Friday blasts, newsletters, and travel promos; nothing needs you.

recipe.why: Autumn is peak foraging season, when wild chanterelles are at their earthy best.

acts.line: A clear stretch in St. Pete before you travel, the one open window of the day.
Wheels up from Tampa mid-afternoon, Toronto-bound.
Land around dinnertime and settle in; the real event is tomorrow.
